messages:
deploy-bot: :rocket: Canary rollout started for release v0.9.18 -> prod by @maya (canary=10%). Watch ingress 5xx/429s and quota metrics.
maya: rolling now. tagging infra + oncall. will monitor rate-limiter and token buckets.
observability-bot: alert: spike in 429 responses (+30%) from gateway for service=api-proxy in canary cluster. dashboard: https://grafana.redwood/ingress/rate-limits
oncall-bot: paging @rachel - canary 429 spike, potential customer impact.
rachel: oncall here, joining. any recent commits touching rate-limiter or gateway config?
maya: the deploy includes commit b7c4d21 which changes default bucket sizing and switches to token-bucket-v2. might be stricter for shared keys.
tom: saw 429s in logs with message `quota_exceeded:key=client_token`. looks like new per-key max_inflight lowered from 50->5. suspect misconfiguration.
observability-bot: sample logs: `WARN quota_exceeded client=partner-x token=abc123 route=/v1/generate` repeated across pods.
pm_sam: customer impact: PartnerX (EU), RetailCo (US) reporting intermittent rejections. Support informed.
support-bot: created ticket INC-5073 (gateway 429s). priority=P1. linked to this thread. assigning support lead.
rachel: quick mitigation options: flip feature flag `rate_limit_v2` -> OFF for canary, or revert commit b7c4d21 on release branch and hotpatch. which is faster?
maya: flag flip is fastest, doing that now for canary to buy time. also prepping revert PR in case flag doesn't fully recover.
tom: agree. I'll prep a revert branch. commands:```
 git checkout -b hotfix/revert-rate-b7c4d21
 git revert --no-edit b7c4d21
 git push origin hotfix/revert-rate-b7c4d21
 hub pull-request -b release -m "hotfix: revert token-bucket-v2 change (b7c4d21)"
```
deploy-bot: feature-flag change detected for canary: `rate_limit_v2=false`. Observability will monitor.
observability-bot: after flag toggle: 429 rate decreased 30% -> 8% within 2m. still above baseline for some keys.
maya: opening revert PR now. CI should run smoke suite. keeping canary at 10% while we validate.
support-bot: INC-5073 updated: affected customers notified (CSMs pinged). workaround=flag toggle.
deploy-bot: CI for hotfix branch green. image built and pushed to canary registry. ready to hotpatch.
tom: applying hotfix to canary: `kubectl set image deploy/api-proxy-canary api-proxy=registry.redwood/api-proxy:v0.9.18-hotfix1` and tailing ingress logs.
observability-bot: after hotpatch and flag off: 429s back to baseline within 4m for most keys; PartnerX now at normal request success.
pm_sam: drafting customer note: brief summary, mitigation, next steps. will circulate for review.
rachel: promoting hotfix to 60% and watching for 20m across regions before stable. handing primary oncall to @tom for next 60m while I work on RCA notes. tom is now primary. :white_check_mark:
tom: accepted. updating status page and ops board. postmortem owners: maya + rachel.
observability-bot: metrics stable for 18m post-promotion: gateway 429s at baseline, p99 latency unchanged.
maya: root cause: bucket size defaults + token-bucket-v2 behavior resulted in overly aggressive throttling for shared client tokens. next steps: add canary config linting, make per-key defaults conservative, add key-level smoke tests.
pm_sam: customer note finalised and sent to impacted CSMs.
support-bot: INC-5073: customers marked notified; support monitoring for follow-ups.
rachel: will keep watch for another 30m then close. thanks everyone for fast coord.
deploy-bot: Incident transition: degraded -> mitigated. Incident ID INC-5073. :lock_with_ink_pen:
